title: Navy Yard job in World War II and practicing with Tom and Eddie
summary: After the WPA, Love lands a Navy Yard job and practices music with Tom Alvors and Eddie Benson near the gate.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: He's got... He's got... For him... Beansy. You work for him during World War II. After I first walked all my shoes out going around the WPA office and things. That's where I land that job in the Navy Yard. I'm waiting in that Navy Yard now and nothing but a baby kid. That's the time I was playing music with Tom Alvors.
And Eddie Benson. We used to practice right over the way from the gate.
